race.comment: OUTPOST (10) is the top pick on the strength of his proven 1200m record and his ability to handle this track-and-trip scenario. He was only beaten just over two lengths at Balaklava last start and his previous Gawler run had enough interference late to give him another chance, while the wet-track record adds further substance. ZESTIMAN (4) looks the main danger backing up quickly from Saturday company, with his Balaklava third two runs ago reading well and the return to this level looking suitable. NOSIE BY NATURE (2) resumes after five months off and brings a close Murray Bridge trial third, plus a Mildura BM56 win from his last campaign, so he has the right fresh profile if ready to go. STARTIDE (12) has been plain at her past two, but she is a proven track-and-trip winner and the quick back-up with Todd Pannell going on keeps her in the mix.
